_header: DEF_TEMPLATE_V4: a blank alarm definition, not a real alarm. Owner SCOUT (the alarm kit). New edition by SCOUT helper K13 for release ALARM_V1_5 (31 Oct 2026); old file team/RESEARCH/ALARM_DESIGN/KIT_V2/templates/DEF_TEMPLATE_V3.json 1afcc5d78c8d0a06. Every field and every rule the code applies is explained in DEF_TEMPLATE_V4.md beside it. Copy it, replace every REPLACE and the example inputs, keep the shape; this key may stay or go.

claim.one_line: REPLACE: the moment, who must trade or what changes, the expected move and its side, in one line
claim.side_meaning: REPLACE: what +1 and -1 mean as the event's direction (+1 = the event pushes the price up); the lean FADE or FOLLOW goes in your VARIANTS row, never in fire.side
claim.note: REPLACE: the time scale and its reason (never a result); the codes, each read with metric_brief_v2.py

conditions.name: REPLACE: the claim in words, with its unit (example: x, the long liquidations of the minute just ended in USD, above its own top 1 pct of the 14 days before)
REPLACE: a second test in words, or delete this condition (example: the 5 min price change is down, the way forced long sales push)
